Chiu Ying thinks of the time he spent with everyone, of how he had lived here all his life and been good friends with each of them. But now he has to watch them leave one by one and this hilltop disappear bit by bit... The hilltop taught him much and gave him many unforgettable experiences, but today he seems unable to do anything or stop selfish people’s evil deeds...
